research_scope: Final Parallel Quest skills from PQ178-186, covering Future Saga Chapter 2 continuation, Future Saga Chapter 3, and Future Saga Chapter 4. Non-skill rewards excluded; exact probabilities left unresolved unless explicitly established.

verification_audit.method: Reconciled PQ numbering and reward identities against the current all-186 PQ guide and Ultimate Finish requirement references. Community reports were used only to corroborate RNG behavior, not to infer probabilities.

duplicate_screening.notes: Only skill rewards attributable to PQ178-186 were included; Super Souls, clothing, accessories, artwork, and non-skill rewards were excluded.
